summary: Drive mutation harness issues 4346, 4457, 4493, 4494 to terminal states.
retrospective:
## Retrospective

Learnings captured from this session:

1. Shadow PYTHONPATH injection fails when the package uses an editable install with a custom MetaPathFinder. The finder intercepts `import scripts` before PYTHONPATH is consulted and always redirects to the repo root. Solution: use a git worktree so the editable install in the isolated worktree points to the mutation tree.

2. The taste-count baseline must be compared against `refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`, not just the local baseline file. A branch created from an older origin/main can have a stale baseline.

3. Rebase onto origin/main before push to pick up any lowered baselines from concurrent PRs.

4. The worktree isolation approach (Issue #4457) eliminates the need for the pre-push marker gate (Issue #4346 item 4) because no tracked file is ever modified.
